characters: Girl has amber-gold eyes and waist-length straight deep-indigo hair; Boy has warm gray-brown eyes and half-tied black hair with natural fringe; both are youthful adults and preserve approved faces
wardrobe: Girl wears moon-white Chinese right-lapel top and deep-indigo mamian skirt with thin cinnabar accents; Boy wears rice-white Chinese right-lapel robe, blue-gray sleeveless outer layer and indigo sash
scene: ancient Chinese Jiangnan canal town with white walls, black tiled roofs, stone bridge, willow and riverside painting stall; no modern or Japanese elements
camera: 16:9 cinematic frame with layered foreground midground background and stable screen direction within the sequence
style: original New Gongbi cinematic 2D animation, meticulous Chinese line art, blue-green mineral pigments, subtle silk grain, crisp contrast, cool shadows and clean golden highlights, never sepia
props: exactly one old deep-indigo Chinese oil-paper umbrella with bamboo ribs and wooden handle; gold sun appears only on its inner surface when specified
